chapters.title: Power Generation
chapters.shortIntro: TU / IOE Engineering electrical engineering: Power Generation.

introduction.overview:
Power Generation is a critical chapter in the Power Systems course offered under the electrical engineering program at TU / IOE Engineering. Engineering students must develop a deep understanding of this topic as it forms the basis for professional engineering practice.

The chapter combines theoretical analysis with practical problem-solving. Students should work through solved examples, practice unsolved problems, and relate theoretical concepts to real-world engineering applications.

Laboratory sessions and tutorial classes complement the lecture content. Students are advised to maintain a problem-solving notebook and regularly review past examination papers for this subject.

Mastery of Power Generation is essential not only for university examinations but also for a successful engineering career.
introduction.whyItMatters: Critical for electrical engineering students — Power Generation is fundamental to professional practice and regularly tested in university examinations.

topics.name: Fundamentals of Power Generation
topics.explanation:
This topic covers the essential theoretical foundations of Power Generation as studied in electrical engineering. Students learn key principles, derivations, and problem-solving methodologies.

Engineering students should focus on understanding the underlying physics/mathematics rather than memorizing formulas.
topics.examTip: Show all derivation steps in exams. Partial marks are significant in engineering examinations.

topics.name: Applications and Design
topics.explanation: Advanced applications of Power Generation in engineering design and analysis. This topic covers practical calculations, design criteria, and real-world engineering challenges.
topics.examTip: Relate theoretical concepts to Nepal's engineering context where possible — examiners appreciate practical awareness.
